questions.question: Who made history as the youngest driver ever to win the Formula One World Drivers' Championship at just 20 years old?
questions.explanation: Italian driver Kimi Antonelli secured the F1 title for Mercedes after finishing on the podium in Mexico.
questions.context: 2026 Formula One World Championship: In open-wheel racing, Italian driver Kimi Antonelli, driving for Mercedes, wins the Formula One World Drivers' Championship after finishing third at the Mexico City Grand Prix, becoming the youngest Drivers' Champion at the age of 20 years and 68 days.

questions.question: A newly approved low-cost generic injection taken just twice a year is set to help prevent which health condition in over 100 developing nations?
questions.explanation: Regulators approved a generic version of lenacapavir, a biannual injection designed to prevent HIV infection at an affordable annual price.
questions.context: The United States Food and Drug Administration approves the first generic version of lenacapavir, a twice-yearly HIV prevention injection expected to cost about US$40 annually in 120 low- and middle-income countries.

questions.question: Supermarkets across several European nations recently experienced cyberattacks that compromised which specific type of equipment?
questions.explanation: Hackers targeted cooling systems in supermarkets, causing temperatures to rise and food to spoil.
questions.context: 2026 French supermarket refrigerator hack: A second wave of cyberattacks target freezers and refrigerators in supermarkets in multiple European countries, causing them to overheat and spoil.

questions.question: Human rights organizations expressed concern after Spain deported a group of migrants from its North African enclave of Ceuta to which neighbouring country?
questions.explanation: Spain transferred sixteen migrants back to Morocco, prompting criticism over the recipient country's human rights record.
questions.context: The Spanish interior ministry reportedly deports 16 migrants, including those from Bangladesh, Cameroon, Nigeria, Senegal, and Yemen, from Ceuta to Morocco following the migrant crisis in July. Amnesty International raises concerns with the move given Morocco's human rights violations.

questions.question: Which body of water saw military escalation when US strikes targeted locations following missile attacks on American aircraft?
questions.explanation: American forces conducted air strikes in response to surface-to-air missile fire directed at their planes near the Strait of Hormuz.
questions.context: Middle Eastern crisis > 2026 Iran war: The United States military carries out airstrikes on Iranian targets across the Strait of Hormuz after Iranian surface-to-air missiles attack American aircraft in the Strait, as explosions are reportedly heard on Qeshm Island and the city of Bandar Lengeh.
